newtonian-physics.title: Newtonian Physics
newtonian-physics.ladder_hint: motion & reference frames; the three laws; forces & free-body diagrams; energy & work; momentum & collisions; circular motion & gravitation; oscillation; where Newton breaks (relativity/quantum teaser)

llms.title: Large Language Models
llms.ladder_hint: tokens & embeddings; next-token prediction as the objective; the transformer at scale; pretraining data & scaling laws; fine-tuning & RLHF; prompting & in-context learning; capabilities & failure modes (hallucination, jailbreaks); evaluation

ai-agents.title: AI Agents
ai-agents.ladder_hint: what makes a model an agent (loop, goals, tools); tool use & function calling; planning & decomposition; memory & state; multi-agent systems; evaluation & reliability; safety (reward hacking, prompt injection, sandboxing); agent infrastructure in practice

agi-and-beyond.title: AGI and Beyond
agi-and-beyond.ladder_hint: defining general intelligence; forecasting & scaling debates; alignment problem fundamentals; interpretability; governance & competition dynamics; economic transformation scenarios; epistemics — how to reason about deep uncertainty honestly (this topic must present contested claims as contested)

odes.title: Ordinary Differential Equations
odes.ladder_hint: what an ODE says; separable equations; linear first-order & integrating factors; exponential growth/decay models; second-order linear & oscillation; systems & phase portraits; equilibria & stability; numerical methods (Euler, RK4)

fourier-series.title: Fourier Series
fourier-series.ladder_hint: periodic functions & superposition; orthogonality of sines/cosines; computing coefficients as integrals; convergence & Gibbs phenomenon; complex form; the spectrum view of signals; toward the Fourier transform

pdes.title: Partial Differential Equations
pdes.ladder_hint: partial derivatives & what a PDE states; the big three (heat, wave, Laplace) as physical stories; boundary & initial conditions; separation of variables (where Fourier series earn their keep); classification & behavior; numerical solution idea; where PDEs run the modern world

quant-finance.title: Quantitative Finance
quant-finance.ladder_hint: returns & compounding conventions; risk measures (vol, Sharpe/Sortino, drawdown); portfolio theory & why MVO is fragile; factors (value/momentum/quality) and why most selection studies die out-of-sample; backtesting discipline (overfitting, selection bias, holdout spending); position sizing (Kelly, vol targeting); regime & tail risk; the honest-research loop (pre-registration, kill criteria)

investing-with-etfs.title: Investing with ETFs
investing-with-etfs.ladder_hint: what an ETF is (creation/redemption, the tax-efficient wrapper); reading a fund (expense ratios gross vs net, AUM, spread, tracking error, the prospectus); fund taxonomy incl. why levered/inverse decay surprises people; building a portfolio (core-satellite, diversified vs sector, the style box); execution (limit orders, premium/discount); costs & taxes; common failure modes

options-and-iv.title: Trading Options & Implied Volatility
options-and-iv.ladder_hint: option mechanics (calls/puts, payoffs, moneyness); no-arbitrage & put-call parity; Black-Scholes as a diffusion — it is the heat equation in disguise (bridge to the PDEs pack); the Greeks as partial derivatives; implied volatility — inverting the model for the market's price of uncertainty, IV vs realized; the vol surface (smile/skew, term structure); trading structures & IV positioning (covered calls, verticals, condors, IV rank); failure modes (short-vol blowups, earnings crush, assignment, liquidity)
